articles.title: Linuxカーネルの深刻な脆弱性「PwnEscape」（CVE-2026-99999）、ゲストの仮想マシンからホスト側Linux OSに不正なコードを実行できる可能性
articles.author: jniino
articles.summary: 悪意のある攻撃者がLinuxの仮想マシンを不正に操作することで、仮想マシンの境界を抜けてホスト側のLinux OSで不正なコードを実行できる可能性がある脆弱性「PwnEscape」（CVE-2026-99999）の情報が公開されています。 ...

articles.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
articles.summary: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.

articles.title: Reverse Engineer Anything Project Brings AI Agents to Binary Analysis
articles.author: Renato Losio
articles.summary: Reverse Engineer Anything (REA) is an open-source project with over 200K GitHub stars that connects coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to reverse-engineering tools like Ghidra, Hopper, and IDA. The project lets developers inspect compiled binaries, trace function calls, and investigate how applications implement specific features. By Renato Losio

articles.title: Amazon Acquires DuckLabs and Integrates DuckDB in Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL
articles.author: Gianmarco Nalin
articles.summary: Amazon has acquired DuckLabs, the company behind the analytical database DuckDB. Co-founders Hannes Mühleisen and Mark Raasveldt will continue to lead the team under AWS. The acquisition aims to enhance the development and reach of DuckDB while maintaining its open-source status. Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL gets its first DuckDB-powered feature following the acquisition. By Gianmarco Nalin
